title: Human-in-the-loop AI copilot improves topology-optimized structure design
summary: MIT’s November 13, 2026 announcement describes a machine-learning copilot that flags regions for human edits during topology optimization. It reports improved manufacturability and buckling-load performance, but the reviewed announcement identifies no separate structural discovery or experimentally demonstrated new structure beyond testing the design workflow. Synthetic feedback training and limited thickening/thinning edits are acknowledged. The full journal paper was not assessed. The publisher abstract specifies improved manufacturability or a 39% linear-buckling-load improvement; it does not assign 39% to both metrics. The paper was published November 10; this entry represents the November 13 announcement.
